description: This file defines the OrderValidator class for validating Order objects within the OpenMRS system, including various validation rules for order fields, date constraints, and associations between order, encounter, and patient entities.

classes.name: OrderValidator
classes.description: A validator class used to enforce constraints and validation rules on Order instances within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the provided class is supported by this validator, specifically if it's assignable from Order.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an Order object, applying rules to fields such as date constraints, patient and encounter consistency, and order type correctness, adding errors as needed.

methods.name: validateOrderTypeClass
methods.description: Verifies that the Order's type matches its class.

methods.name: validateDateActivated
methods.description: Validates the dateActivated field against current date, autoExpireDate, dateStopped, and encounter datetime constraints.

methods.name: validateSamePatientInOrderAndEncounter
methods.description: Ensures that the patient associated with the order matches the patient in the related encounter.

methods.name: validateScheduledDate
methods.description: Validates scheduledDate based on the urgency setting.

methods.name: validateOrderGroupEncounter
methods.description: Checks that the order's encounter matches the encounter of its order group, if applicable.

methods.name: validateOrderGroupPatient
methods.description: Checks that the order's patient matches the patient of its order group, if applicable.
